title: Product-CM intersections of Hodge-generic curves in A2
exact_target: Let C be a reduced irreducible closed curve over Qbar in the moduli space A2 of principally polarized abelian surfaces, contained in no proper special subvariety. Are there only finitely many points of C whose abelian surface is isogenous to a product of two elliptic curves with at least one factor having complex multiplication?
